description: Window / table-calc TRANSLATION across all supported families. A dataset-level CreateColumnsOperation contributes runningSum (running), stdevOver (statistical → STDDEV_SAMP OVER PARTITION BY), percentileOver (windowed PERCENTILE_CONT WITHIN GROUP ... OVER), percentileRank (PERCENT_RANK() OVER ... ORDER BY ... × 100), and periodToDateSumOverTime YEAR (date-anchored YTD: SUM OVER PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', date) ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING→CURRENT ROW). An analysis-level CalculatedField adds percentOfTotal. All lower to kind:'sql' helper elements with explicit SQL OVER / WITHIN GROUP clauses (mirrors the Tableau table-calc path) instead of silently erroring as Sigma DM calc columns. Verifies the helper elements POST cleanly with zero error columns (every OVER/WITHIN GROUP column resolves to a concrete warehouse type, not error/Null). Partition/order/period are extracted from the QS expression args; the base aggregation grain comes from the visual grouping dims when available. Calcs whose partition/order/percentile/date can't be determined still degrade to Null (translate-where-determinable, degrade-where-not).
